purpose: Separate coarse-cell microtopographic route fidelity from terrain-relative vertical airspace fidelity.

axes.semantics: terrain elevation from 30 m ASTER DEM, m amsl
GPS height above mean sea level, m

interpretation.terrain_positive: repeatable sub-cell choice of terrain elevations/ridges/valleys
interpretation.agl_positive: repeatable vertical airspace use relative to local ground
interpretation.note: The three components are not assumed statistically additive.

claim_boundary: Exploratory component decomposition; cannot replace frozen primary AMSL or AGL endpoints.
